_comment: CRON-86: Qilin (麒麟) — divine beast, very rare. Per canon, Wang Lin encounters the 麒灵 beast-city in the 修魔海 (Sea of Devils) arc; the Qilin is a sacred creature associated with the beast-cities of the sea. Weight 1 = extremely rare (divine beast, not a common spawn). Spawning restricted to the Sea of Devils and its sub-biomes.
